description: This file declares the Scheduler class responsible for managing thread pools, error states, dependencies, and build tasks within a build system, specifically for the GN build tool.

classes.name: Scheduler
classes.description: Manages thread pool, dependencies, and build task states for the build system.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Starts the scheduler's main execution loop.

methods.name: task_runner
methods.description: Returns the main thread's message loop.

methods.name: input_file_manager
methods.description: Provides access to the input file manager.

methods.name: set_verbose_logging
methods.description: Enables or disables verbose logging.

methods.name: is_failed
methods.description: Checks if the scheduler has encountered a failure.

methods.name: Log
methods.description: Logs a message with a specified verb.

methods.name: FailWithError
methods.description: Marks the scheduler as failed with an error.

methods.name: ScheduleWork
methods.description: Schedules a unit of work to be executed.

methods.name: Shutdown
methods.description: Shuts down the scheduler.

methods.name: AddGenDependency
methods.description: Adds a file as a build dependency.

methods.name: GetGenDependencies
methods.description: Returns the list of generated dependencies.

methods.name: AddWrittenFile
methods.description: Tracks a file that has been written.

methods.name: AddWriteRuntimeDepsTarget
methods.description: Schedules a target for writing runtime dependencies.

methods.name: GetWriteRuntimeDepsTargets
methods.description: Returns targets scheduled for runtime deps.

methods.name: IsFileGeneratedByWriteRuntimeDeps
methods.description: Checks if a file was generated by write runtime deps.

methods.name: AddGeneratedFile
methods.description: Tracks a generated file.

methods.name: IsFileGeneratedByTarget
methods.description: Checks if a file was generated by a specific target.

methods.name: AddUnknownGeneratedInput
methods.description: Adds an input file declared by a target but not generated by dependencies.

methods.name: GetUnknownGeneratedInputs
methods.description: Returns all unknown generated inputs.

methods.name: ClearUnknownGeneratedInputsAndWrittenFiles
methods.description: Clears internal tracking of unknown inputs and written files (for testing).

methods.name: IncrementWorkCount
methods.description: Increments the internal work counter.

methods.name: DecrementWorkCount
methods.description: Decrements the internal work counter.

methods.name: SuppressOutputForTesting
methods.description: Suppresses output during testing.
